title: A Heritage of Excellence on Kyegobe Hill
text: For more than a century, St. Leo's College Kyegobe has shaped disciplined, capable and morally upright young people within a serene, purposeful and well-resourced campus.

title: Rigorous Academics, Dedicated Mentorship
text: Qualified teachers, structured study programmes and a culture of high expectation enable every learner to reach their full intellectual potential.

title: Faith, Character and Service
text: Rooted in the Catholic tradition, we form the whole person: mind, spirit and body, preparing graduates who lead with integrity and compassion.
